visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit department store setting. A large white oval sign with the brand name 'kakaii' and Chinese text stands prominently in the foreground. In the background, a person in a white shirt walks past a counter area filled with kitchenware and promotional displays. (2) The camera pans across a shelf displaying several beige and grey fabric travel compression bags and totes. A promotional poster behind the bags shows them in a lifestyle setting. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a black pegboard wall holding various kitchen items, including a white frying pan with a wooden handle and grey cutting boards. Yellow variety-style text overlays appear on the screen. (4) The scene shifts to show more travel bags stacked on shelves, transitioning into a close-up of a promotional sign detailing price points for different bag sets. (5) A hand enters the frame to pick up and display a beige ceramic pot from a white metal stand. The background shows more cookware and product packaging. (6) A woman with short brown hair, wearing a white top and blue denim overalls, appears. She models a large beige tote bag on her shoulder and then holds up a smaller version of the same bag, smiling at the camera. (7) Close-up shots follow of various kitchen tools: a clear plastic dry food container, beige silicone spatulas, and tongs hanging on a pegboard. (8) The camera pans over a row of grey and beige cutting boards of different sizes. (9) A display featuring cartoon tiger and cat characters on an apron and signs is shown, indicating a brand collaboration. (10) The final phase shows close-up shots of boxed kitchen knives and a sign listing special event promotions and gift tiers based on spending amounts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with an energetic male voice introducing the brand 'Kakaii' over a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar track. The tone is welcoming and enthusiastic. (2) A subtle 'ding' sound effect highlights a text transition as the speaker mentions the location of the pop-up store. (3) The narration continues at a fast, conversational pace, detailing the travel bag combinations and prices, with the upbeat background music maintaining a consistent energy. (4) As the focus shifts to cookware, the speaker's pitch modulates slightly to emphasize safety features like being 'PFAS-free'. (5) A light 'pop' SFX is heard as new variety text appears, matching the description of the insulated lunch bags and kitchen tools. (6) The voice maintains high arousal while explaining the collaboration with 'SongSong Meow' and 'Xiao Lao Fu', with the guitar music continuing uninterrupted. (7) The final phase features the speaker listing the promotion tiers ('buy 5000 get...'), ending with a friendly call to action to visit the store.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Product Showcase -> Brand Collaboration -> Promotional Offers -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a temporary pop-up store for the home goods brand 'Kakaii' at the Uni-President Department Store in Taipei. It aims to drive foot traffic by showcasing a wide range of aesthetic and functional products like travel bags, cookware, and kitchen tools while highlighting exclusive event-only discounts and gifts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is a dedicated showcase for 'kakaii' products, featuring the founder's narration, clear brand logos, store location info, and specific price/promotion details.
